texts.facts: The balance sheet of the hotels are prepared commonly by the IHCL. Therefore, all the units of IHCL should be treated and governed uniformly. Hence, so far as the employees of the IHCL are concerned, they should be treated at par in all respect. difference in superannuation age is based on no reasonable classification. The retirement age under the brand name TATA should be uniformly 60 years and not 55 or 58 years. The difference of retirement age is highly discriminatory, illegal and arbitrary. In fact, this is in violation of the fundamental right of equality of the employees of the IHCL and also amounts to unfair labour practice. Although age of superannuation is a matter of policy, the policy must be consistent and non-discriminatory. The management of IHCL, Since the retirement age of employees in other companies under the brand name TATA is 60 years, there is no reason the same should not be adopted for the employee of IHCL uniformly. During the course of the conciliation proceedings, the management enhanced the retirement age to 58 years effective from 20th January, 2015 and further to 60 years thus, excluding the workman from the benefits of the enhancement of age of retirement, which is not only illegal and arbitrary but also amounts to unfair labour practice and shows the flippant attitude of the managements towards their retired employees who devoted major part of their life working for the managements. All the employees who have ID NO. 422/2019 Anil Kumar Banaik vs. Taj Mahal Hotel & Ors. retired should be adequately compensated for the loss of years of service. The services of the Claimant automatically came to an end on attaining the age of superannuation viz. 55 years. It is an admitted position that the age of superannuation of employees in the Taj Mahal Hotel, Delhi at the relevant time was 55 years. Hence, the Claimant had no right, much less any legal right, to continue in employment after attaining the age of superannuation. ID NO. 422/2019 Anil Kumar Banaik vs. Taj Mahal Hotel & Ors. In terms of a statutory Anil Kumar Banaik vs Taj Mahal Hotel And Ors on 24 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/44417682/ 5 settlement dated 20.01.2015 entered into by the management with the workmen concerned as represented by Taj Mahal Hotel Workers Union under the Industrial Disputes Act, w.e.f 20.01.2015, the age of retirement/superannuation of the workmen of Taj Mahal Hotel who were on the rolls of the management on the said date, has been raised to 58 years. ID NO. 422/2019 Anil Kumar Banaik vs. Taj Mahal Hotel & Ors.
texts.arguments: 7. In his separate rejoinders to the WS of Management No. 1 and 2, the Claimant has controverted the pleas of the managements in the written statements and has reiterated those of his claim.
